values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: An open grassy clearing beside Shanerburg Road, full sun, 1.2 miles down from Worlds End Road; parking is a short gravel strip parallel to the road. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs, though its campsite map layer calls it a large open site suitable for a large trailer or RV; the pad is listed as 25 by 30 ft. A marsh lies in the woods about 60 m away. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
